commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: ci: move the workflow actions onto Node 24
commits.body:
Every action the three workflows use still targets Node 20, which the runners now
force onto Node 24 with a deprecation warning, so the pinned versions were
already not describing what runs. Each one moves to its current major, where the
runtime is node24 for real.

Nothing in the bumps changes how this repo builds: setup-java's breaking change
covers JetBrains pre-releases and the builds ask for temurin, setup-node's
automatic caching needs a packageManager field that web/package.json does not
have and a cache is configured explicitly anyway, and upload-pages-artifact now
drops dotfiles from the artifact, which the Vite output does not produce.
setup-android is the one real change of behaviour: v4 defaults to cmdline-tools
20.0.

commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix(web): keep the settings row-span rule
commits.body:
The mixed-content warning was the reason `.field-row-span` was written, but never
its only caller: the server name field also asks for the whole row, and dropping
the declaration alongside the warning left that name back in half of a
two-column grid, sharing a line with the backend picker.

The rule is back, commented for the caller it still has, and a regression check
now ties the two together so the next cleanup cannot delete one without the
other.

commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix(web): give the waiting marker a colour that exists
commits.body:
The desktop marker painted itself with `--secondary` and `--secondary-soft`, and
the palette declares neither: the whole `background-image` is invalid at
computed-value time, so it falls back to `none` and the strip renders
transparent. The state the issue asked to see at a glance was invisible, and the
regression check could not tell, because it reads the rule as text.

Both tokens are now declared, violet in either theme, reusing the values the
harness badges already proved against these backgrounds. The checks that follow
are over the whole sheet: no `var()` without a fallback may point at an
undeclared name, and nothing may be declared for dark mode alone. That second
one turned up `.help-content .note`, painting itself with a `--text-secondary`
that never existed, so it takes `--muted` like every other muted line.

commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix(web): let the message menu close, and copy where the API is absent
commits.body:
`close()` only cleared the long-press timer, so nothing ever put the menu away
except choosing one of its items: a press elsewhere left it hanging over the
transcript, and since the state belongs to each bubble, right-clicking a second
message added a second menu rather than moving the first. It now answers to a
press outside, Escape, a scroll of the pane under it, and a resize. Pressing an
item stops that press from counting as "outside", which would otherwise unmount
the menu before the click reached the button.

The copy itself assumed `navigator.clipboard`. It only exists in a secure
context, and this app is also meant to be served over plain http on a LAN, where
the property is undefined and reaching through it throws before there is a
promise for `.catch()` to take — no copy, no message, an error in the console.
The write is guarded and falls back to the selection copy, which is all that
still works there.
